P: Samaṅgitā，（f．） [abstr．fr．foll．] the fact of being endowed or connected with （--°） J．III，95 （paraloka°）； VbhA．438 （fivefold：āyūhana° etc．）．（Page 681）

ပြည့်စုံသည်၏အဖြစ်။

samaṅgī.p: [ samaṅga + ī.saṃ + añja + ṇī. Samañjanaṃ samaṅgo, so etassa atthīti samaṅgī. Samannāgato. Samañjanasīlo vā samaṅgī. Ma, ṭī, 3. 302. Aṃ, ṭī, 1. 220. Samañjanasīlo samaṅgī. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 220. Thī-၌ samaṅginī. Sama + aṅgina-samaṅgina-vilyaṃ, sakkatapiṭaka. ] (ti) Google Translate (1) together-being-completely-smeared-mixed, Complete. (2) Commonly mixed together. (3) There is an association with each other.
pn: Samaṅgī. The wife of Sobhita Buddha before his renunciation (Bv.vii.18). The Buddhavaṁsa Commentary calls her Makhiladevī. Bv-a.137.

R:
samaṅgī：သမင်္ဂီ （တိ） （သံ+အင်္ဂီ）
ပြည့်စုံသည်။
V: Samangī：The wife of Sobhita Buddha before his renunciation （Bu．vii．18）．The Buddhavamsa Commentary calls her Makhiladevī．BuA．137．

samaṅgībhūta.p: [ samaṅgī + bhūta ] (ti) Google Translate (1) Being together is complete. (2) Being together - coming together as one - not quiet - not quiet - not quiet. (3) To be together - to become well-liked - to stay in the same place - to live together. (4) Being together is complete (period).

samaṅga.p: [ saṃ + añja + a.dhātvattha. Saṃ + agi + a. Nīti, dhātu. 27. Saṃ + aṅga. Samaṅga (ti) saṃ. ] (thī, pu) Google Translate (P) (1) (Full-bodied, William) (Servant of Lord Tissa) Tamang Thera. (2) together-being-completely-smeared-mixed-. (3) Nipse-palm tree (plant) (Thameng--tham.).
pn: Samaṅga 01. The constant attendant of Tissa Buddha. Bv.xviii.21; Bv-a (p. 191) calls him Samata.
